Points.Title: Channel points
Points.Intro: When there are no drops, the app can watch your favorite streamers and collect their channel points. Every channel names them its own way. The bonus that shows up about every 15 minutes is claimed automatically.
Points.How: Twitch only gives points to people watching through a real player, so the app quietly starts a browser without a window. You won't see it; it runs only while points are being collected and uses about 400 MB of memory. As soon as drops show up, the browser closes and the app goes back to them. If you don't need it, just leave it off.
